fieldNotes.resolvedLocation: Geocode (4500 E Mustard Way, Partnership Industrial Center) landed on the correct John Deere Reman building - confirmed by Street View (2026-03) showing the building front with entrance canopy on Mustard Way and the 4500 E Mustard Way address sign at the property.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Open campus - no controlled truck entrance. Employee parking lots front Mustard Way with an open driveway; a single internal driveway loops around the building's SW corner to the south dock yard. No barrier arm, gate, guard booth, or perimeter fence observed in satellite or Street View.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth anywhere on site.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False - no truck gate at the property line.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long internal truck driveway wrapping the building from the road to the south docks; would hold 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock-door bank with visible dock-leveler bays along the SW/south building face; estimated 10-25 total, low-confidence count.
fieldNotes.dropArea: No dedicated trailer drop yard; the south yard holds material laydown (crates, tanks, equipment) and only a few trailers. 0-10 band.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Docks concentrated on the south/SW building face; no separated ship vs. receive clusters.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Located within the Partnership Industrial Center, an established industrial park on the developed northeast side of Springfield, MO (metro of ~475k); classified Urban.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Single large remanufacturing building - not a multi-building campus.
fieldNotes.dropYard: No dedicated trailer-storage lot; reman plant relies on a modest material/staging yard.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail mainline corridor runs along the south edge of the property but no spur enters the site - railServed = false.
